citeAs: Zhang, C., Li, Y., et al. (2025). ArtifactsBench: Bridging the Visual-Interactive Gap in LLM Code Generation Evaluation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2507.04952.
creator: Chenchen Zhang, Yuhang Li, Can Xu, Jiaheng Liu, Ao Liu, Changzhi Zhou, Ken Deng, Dengpeng Wu, Guanhua Huang, Kejiao Li, Qi Yi, Ruibin Xiong, Shihui Hu, Yue Zhang, Yuhao Jiang, Zenan Xu, Yuanxing Zhang, Wiggin Zhou, Chayse Zhou, Fengzong Lian (Tencent)
description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation, containing 1,825 diverse tasks to assess visual fidelity and interactive integrity of LLM-generated code.
name: ArtifactsBench
rai:annotationsPerItem: Dual-referee (2 MLLMs) for automated scoring; multiple engineers for the human validation subset.
rai:annotatorDemographics: Multiple front-end engineers with extensive front-end development experience.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen’s κ ≥ 0.8 among annotators. Pairwise agreement with human experts is up to 90.95%.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. Checklists are LLM-drafted and then human-refined for specificity and screenability.
rai:dataCollection: Candidates are aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
rai:dataLimitations: Evaluates dynamic behavior by capturing and analyzing a sequence of screenshots at fixed intervals, which may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Experts rewrite for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Difficulty is assigned post hoc by aggregated performance of 30+ models.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Two-stage filtering: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts and accelerating the development of user-centric generative models.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Hunyuan-Turbos (for checklist generation), Gemini-2.5-Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-72B (for MLLM-as-Judge evaluation and classification).
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The query quality filtering prompt explicitly checks for privacy, ensuring the question avoids requesting or involving any sensitive personal information, such as phone numbers, addresses, or other identifiable details.
